text:
alex: heads up — noticed a perf regression in canary after the autotune changes. Small-seqlen (<=8) requests on A100 jumped ~18% p95.
liam: ugh saw that on dashboard. pickle: runtime is picking fused_attention_v2 for short sequences now, but previously we used small_seq_kernel which was faster for those buckets.
maya: do we have pick reason telemetry for these events? the telemetry shows `pick_reason=heuristic` but that's too vague.
alex: nope, the current telemetry only logs `kernel_chosen` and `pick_reason` string. i prototyped a more explicit line in logs:
```
[PICK] ts=2001122334 model=rw-v1 kernel=small_seq_kernel reason=SEQ_BUCKET bucket=0 seq_len=6 est_lat_us=0.9 flags=0x4
[PICK] ts=2001122340 model=rw-v1 kernel=fused_attention_v2 reason=HEURISTIC bucket=0 seq_len=6 est_lat_us=1.15 flags=0x5
```
liam: that looks good. important: we must avoid exploding cardinality in metrics. reason should be an enum code + short label, and flags as a bitmask.
maya: agreed. proposal:
- add `pick_reason_code` (int) and `pick_reason` (short string)
- add `pick_flag_mask` (int hex)
- add `seq_bucket` (small int) and `model_arch` (string)
- emit a sample `pick_trace` line for every cold pick (once per model+seq_bucket per minute)
this should let us correlate regressions without high-card metrics.
alex: also suggest env toggle `RK_PICK_TRACE=1` which emits the human lines above to logs for oncall debugging.
liam: +1. for telemetry we should also add counters for fallback paths: `pick_fallback_count` with labels (from,to,reason_code).
maya: autotuner change idea — prefer `small_seq_kernel` for seq_len <= 12 on Ampere unless `quantized` flag is set. current heuristic seems to have an artifact where fused_attn gets preferred due to stale perf model.
alex: i ran microbenchmarks (run id: perf/789) — confirms small_seq_kernel wins for seq<=12 in both bf16 and fp16, except when kv_cache_enabled+batch>8.
liam: sounds like tuning matrix: (seq_bucket, batch_size, kv_cache, quant) -> kernel choice. we should store a small decision table and surface it in telemetry as `decision_source` = {AUTOTUNE_MODEL, STATIC_TABLE, ENV_OVERRIDE}.
maya: implementation plan:
- add pick_trace logging (env + opt-in) — alex takes
- telemetry fields (pick_reason_code, pick_flag_mask, decision_source) — liam takes
- autotune update + regression test matrix and perf runs — i'll take
can we get a quick canary of the pick_trace lines for oncall to validate? runtime-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2001122400.
alex: will open PR with logging and a `RK_PICK_TRACE` env guard, small tests + sample lines.
liam: i'll add telemetry proto + low-cardinality counters in the same PR if alex is comfortable.
maya: ok please tag me on PR. also add a short note to the release notes so support knows how to enable trace if customers report similar spikes.
alex: thanks — i'll start now. link to perf run: https://perf.internal/runs/789 — includes microbench csv and gnuplot.
liam: nice. once PR is up i'll run ci perf harness and post comparisons. :thumbsup:
maya: perfect. if we still see regressions after this, we'll add an automated canary that flips decision_source to STATIC_TABLE for affected models. :eyes:
alex: cheers — will report back once PR is green.
